note: Every cell is one of three kinds. published: the platform's own figure, with the page it is on. measured: our own measurement, with what it ran on. unpublished: we could not find a figure on the pages named in RESEARCH.md, and we do not guess one. showcase.test.ts fails when a cell has no kind, a published cell has no URL, or a measured cell does not say what it ran on.
